resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or any DFT code with GGA+U capability)

access.notes: Standard pseudopotentials (e.g., from SSSP library) are needed.

resources.notes: VASP was used in the paper, but any DFT code that supports GGA+U (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, ABINIT) is acceptable. The agent must use a Hubbard U correction of 4 eV on Zn d states.

access.notes: Known structure; lattice parameters a ≈ 3.25 Å, c ≈ 5.2 Å. The agent constructs the unit cell from public crystallographic data.
